title: Known-Anchor Calibration Mode
negative_results: geographic labels are sealed during transform selection; revealing them before the calibration is frozen is refused (invariant 5)
a retrospective fit stays OPERATOR_HYPOTHESIS and never reaches CALIBRATED_MAPPING
a prospective challenge that reuses a training anchor is refused as non-prospective
an underdetermined affine fit (fewer than dim+1 anchors) is refused
an out-of-range anchor latitude, an empty anchor set, and a non-positive tolerance are refused

claims.statement: A synthetic affine source-semantics transform is fitted to (source_vector, known_point) anchors with geographic labels sealed during selection, and a well-posed calibration reproduces a clean linear anchor mapping (POWER).
A calibration is promoted to CALIBRATED_MAPPING only after a prospective known-destination challenge passes within tolerance; retrospective fit alone is not calibrated.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic anchors only, no private inputs, no real coordinates
